macro.summary: Today is characterized by a violent, broad-based relief bounce with over 90% of stocks rising, fueled by month-end rebalancing flows after steep multi-week declines. However, with the 10-year yield holding near 4.91% and the VIX still at 26.8, this is an oversold recovery rally rather than a clean structural bull market. We are allocating heavily toward tactical trades to capitalize on momentum in relative strength leaders like homebuilders and oversold biotech. We will avoid chasing broken semiconductor trends into the weekend and keep speculative risk tightly controlled.
